name: Spatial Pattern Uniformity and Periodicity

scale_0: Absent or not applicable: microstructure lacks spatial pattern uniformity and periodicity in the field of view.
scale_1: Minimal / sparse manifestation: features show some localized ordering or general consistency in spacing, but with noticeable irregularities or variations across the image, lacking long-range uniformity.
scale_3: Features show some localized ordering or general consistency in spacing, but with noticeable irregularities or variations across the image, lacking long-range uniformity.
scale_5: Features are arranged in a highly ordered, predictable, and repetitive pattern with exceptionally uniform spacing and alignment throughout the entire image.

name: Feature Elongation

scale_0: Absent or not applicable: microstructure lacks feature elongation in the field of view.
scale_1: Features are predominantly equiaxed or slightly elongated, with aspect ratios close to 1:1, or only a small fraction of features are elongated.
scale_3: Features exhibit moderate elongation, appearing as short rods or fibers, with aspect ratios noticeably greater than 1:1 but not extremely slender.
scale_5: Features are highly elongated, appearing as long, slender needles, rods, or fibers, with very high aspect ratios dominating the microstructure.
